note: The manifest of every external input to this tree, code and data alike. Nothing enters the tree undeclared (plan L0 step 3). Entries are pinned by URL and SHA-256, never by version range, because rule R11 applies to code for the same reason it applies to data: upstream is mutable and a resolver hides that. See MANIFEST.md for the format.

entries.licence_note: Boost Software License 1.0. Permissive; plan §5 constraint 3 satisfied. Chosen over doctest (MIT) and GoogleTest (BSD-3) for its floating-point matcher vocabulary — WithinAbs, WithinRel, WithinULP — which is the vocabulary the adopted L1 specifications already state their tolerances in. BSL-1.0 additionally does not require its notice to be reproduced in machine-executable object code, which is a real convenience for a tree whose own licence posture is undecided (LICENSE §2).
entries.upstream_mutable_note: A GitHub release tag archive is immutable in practice but not by guarantee; the SHA-256 is the identity, not the tag.
entries.verify_note: After FetchContent populates this dependency, verify_path inside the populated tree is compared byte-for-byte against the same file inside the hash-pinned archive. A transitive FetchContent_Declare once substituted a different major version of a pinned dependency; this is the check that would have caught it. See PROVENANCE §8.11.

entries.licence_note: CC0 1.0 Universal — a public-domain dedication, the most permissive terms available and comfortably inside plan §5 constraint 3. Header-only, one header. Vendored under decision D7 because std::expected is C++23 and D1 fixed the language at C++20; the API is std::expected's, so the eventual migration is a change of alias. Plan §5 constraint 8 keeps that migration one line: every signature names odl::Result and no monadic operation is used, since construction, checking and unwrapping are where the two are interchangeable and the monadic operations are where they diverge.

entries.role: IAU SOFA algorithms — precession-nutation, Earth rotation, TDB-TT, calendar arithmetic
entries.licence_note: BSD 3-clause. Mandated by plan §5 constraint 1 and chosen over SOFA specifically to avoid SOFA's rename clause; ERFA is derived from SOFA with the SOFA board's permission, recorded in its own LICENSE. This release tracks SOFA "20231011". Note that ERFA ships no CMakeLists.txt — it is autotools only — so this tree builds it with cmake/BuildErfa.cmake rather than adding its subdirectory.
entries.verify_note: Verified against LICENSE rather than CMakeLists.txt, because ERFA has no CMakeLists.txt. Any file present in the pinned archive serves; what matters is that the comparison is against the hash-pinned bytes.

entries.role: reads SPK kernels; the ephemeris interpolation (SPEC-ephemerides §3.4)
entries.licence_note: TRIPLE-LICENSED, AND THE CHOICE IS RECORDED HERE BECAUSE IT HAS TO BE MADE. CALCEPH's own LICENSE: "The library is 'triple-licensed' (CeCILL-C, CeCILL-B or CeCILL), you have to choose one of the three licenses below to apply on the library." This tree chooses CeCILL-B, the BSD-like option. It is the ONLY one of the three compatible with plan §5 constraint 3: CeCILL-C is close to the GNU LGPL and CeCILL v2.1 is GPL-compatible, and tools/fetch.py's allowlist refuses both by name. Note that neither contains the string 'GPL', so the denylist this project used until 2026-09-18 would have passed them. OBLIGATIONS, heavier than BSD's and binding a FUTURE distribution rather than this tree today: CeCILL-B §5.3.4 CREDITS requires a distributor of MODIFIED software to state that it is based on CALCEPH, reproduce the intellectual-property notice, make that notice reachable from the software's interface, and mention it on a freely accessible website for as long as it is distributed. This tree links CALCEPH unmodified. The predecessor links it statically and records no choice at all, which is the situation this entry exists not to inherit.

entries.version: through IERS Bulletin C 72, July 2026; expires 2027-06-28
entries.licence_note: IERS public product, published by the Earth Orientation Centre for unrestricted use. Not redistributed by this tree: the pin is the IERS's own URL and the hash is the identity.
entries.upstream_mutable_note: Rewritten whenever a leap second is announced. That is precisely why it is pinned: a change here is a change of one second, which is 7.5 km of along-track position at LEO, and it must be a reviewed act rather than something a re-fetch does quietly. The file also states its own expiry, which SPEC-time TIME-R-051 enforces as a refusal with exactly one named, logged escape hatch.

entries.role: IERS EOP 20 C04 — the final Earth orientation series (SPEC-eop §4.1)
entries.licence_note: IERS public product. Not redistributed: the pin is the IERS's own URL.
entries.upstream_mutable_note: THIS IS THE ARCHIVED PATH, deliberately, per plan §3.11 point 3. The live series at .../eopc04/ is revised RETROACTIVELY at an unchanged URL — three documented instances (2025-06-05, 2026-02-05, 2026-03-09), two of which rewrote historical pole coordinates for 2021-2024. The IERS archives each superseded solution at a stable path as it retires it, so pinning one records a URL and redistributes nothing. Operational runs may use the live series; they must record its identity and hash in run provenance.

entries.role: IERS Rapid Service / Prediction Centre finals2000A.all — rapid and predicted EOP
entries.upstream_mutable_note: Rewritten daily. NOTE THE 2000A IN THE NAME: finals.all carries dPsi/dEps against IAU 1980, finals2000A.all carries dX/dY against IAU 2000A. The layouts are identical and nothing detects the substitution at parse time, so this manifest entry's identity is the only guard (SPEC-eop §3.2, EOP-R-002).

entries.role: EGM2008 fully normalised spherical harmonic coefficients to degree 2190, order 2159 — the field SPEC-gravity implements

extract.role: the scaling parameters, record format and tide system (GRAV-R-011, GRAV-R-015)

entries.licence_note: NGA publishes EGM2008 for unrestricted use; the README asks that Pavlis, Holmes, Kenyon and Factor (EGU 2008) be cited, which PROVENANCE.md §4 does. Data, never linked. THE ARCHIVE ALSO CONTAINS hsynth_WGS84.f AND hsynth_WGS84.exe, a FORTRAN harmonic-synthesis program and its binary. Neither is extracted and neither was opened: plan §3.3 step 2 says this tree's recursions come from published mathematics rather than from anyone's code, and declaring the archive whole while consuming two of its seven members is what makes that claim checkable rather than merely asserted. Zeta-to-N_to2160_egm2008 (142 MB) is not extracted either; it is the geoid conversion expansion, which GRAV-Q-002 ruled out of scope.

entries.role: NGA.STND.0036 — WGS 84 normal gravity at the pole and the semi-minor axis, for GRAV-A-012's external band check
entries.licence_note: Pinned for exactly two numbers — gamma_p = 9.8321849379 m/s^2 and b = 6356752.3142 m (Table 3.6, Table 3.1) — which are the only expected values in SPEC-gravity §8 that come from outside this tree's own mathematics. Note that its GM, 3986004.418e8 m^3 s^-2, IS NUMERICALLY the TCG-compatible EGM2008 value under another name, so it cannot be refused on its value; what GRAV-F-005 refuses is taking both constants from here, since this document's semi-major axis is 6378137.0 m against EGM2008's reference radius of 6378136.3 m.
